rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for violently breaking something or for something being broken into pieces.

example.english: They smash the glass when they get angry.
example.traditional: 佢一嬲就將個玻璃杯打爛咗。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 nau1 zau6 zoeng1 go3 bo1 lei4 bui1 daa2 laan6 zo2

rows.note: Use this when the focus is on hitting with great force rather than on the object breaking.

example.english: Don't smash the door so hard; you'll wake everyone up.
example.traditional: 你唔好大力打個門，會嘈醒晒啲人㗎！
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 daai6 lik6 daa2 go3 mun4 wui5 cou4 seng2 saai3 di1 jan4 gaa3

rows.note: Use this in colloquial sports or competition contexts when one side defeats the other by a very large margin.

example.english: Our team can smash the opponents every game.
example.traditional: 我哋隊今年場場都大炒對手。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 deoi6 gam1 nin4 coeng4 coeng4 dou1 daai6 caau2 deoi3 sau2
